title: 复合句型训练
intro: 先判断句子缺什么成分，再选择连接结构；每类先看原理与拆解，再完成6道新情境迁移题。
source_note: 以用户提供的Task 1水果罐头流程图四句练习为切入点；water、packaged已校正。其他例句、中文提示、迁移题及练习数据为教学整理，不是官方评分范文，也不替代原图。

case_study.en: The diagram illustrates the process by which canned fruit is produced and prepared for sale in supermarkets.
case_study.cn: 该图展示了水果罐头的生产及为超市销售做准备的过程。
case_study.clause: by which canned fruit is produced and prepared for sale in supermarkets
case_study.role: by which＝by this process；which是介词by的宾语
split: The diagram illustrates the process.
Canned fruit is produced and prepared for sale in supermarkets by this process.

case_study.en: Initially, fresh fruit is packed and transported to a factory, where it is sorted to remove unsuitable produce.
case_study.cn: 首先，新鲜水果被包装并运到工厂，在那里经过分拣以去除不合适的果品。
case_study.main: Fresh fruit is packed and transported to a factory.
case_study.clause: where it is sorted to remove unsuitable produce
split: Fresh fruit is packed and transported to a factory.
At the factory, it is sorted to remove unsuitable produce.
case_study.note: 用户提供的流程图练习句；依原图确认实际加工顺序。

case_study.en: The prepared fruit is subsequently placed in cans, to which either water, juice or syrup is added.
case_study.cn: 随后，处理好的水果被装入罐中，再向罐中加入水、果汁或糖浆中的一种。
case_study.main: The prepared fruit is subsequently placed in cans.
case_study.clause: to which either water, juice or syrup is added
case_study.role: add liquid to cans→liquid is added to cans；which是to的宾语
split: The prepared fruit is subsequently placed in cans.
Either water, juice or syrup is added to these cans.
case_study.note: water已校正；to which表示添加的目标容器。

case_study.en: Finally, the packaged cans are transported to supermarkets, where they are ready for sale.
case_study.cn: 最后，包装好的罐头被运往超市，在那里准备出售。
case_study.main: The packaged cans are transported to supermarkets.
case_study.clause: where they are ready for sale
split: The packaged cans are transported to supermarkets.
There, they are ready for sale.
case_study.note: packaged已校正；where表示超市这一地点。

lessons.title: 01 关系代词：who / whom / whose / which / that
lessons.goal: 判断关系词在从句中充当主语、宾语还是所有格。
lessons.principle: 定语从句修饰前面的名词。先把主句和从句拆成两句，找出重复的名词，再看它在从句中缺少什么成分；不要仅凭先行词是人还是物选关系词。
steps: 找先行词：需要补充说明的人或物。
还原从句：缺主语、宾语，还是“谁的＋名词”？
选择关系词，删除重复的he / it / them，保留必要的谓语。

rules.example: Students who practise regularly tend to improve.
rules.explanation: who代替students，作practise的主语；主语关系词不能省略。

rules.example: The tutor whom the college hired has extensive experience.
rules.explanation: the college hired the tutor；正式写作可用whom。介词紧邻关系词之前时用whom，不用who/that。

rules.structure: 物＋which / that＋谓语或主语＋谓语
rules.example: The device that measures temperature is replaced annually.
rules.explanation: that作measures的主语；the device that engineers installed中that作installed的宾语。

rules.use: 表示所属关系，人或物均可
rules.example: Schools whose facilities are outdated need investment.
rules.explanation: whose facilities＝the schools’ facilities；whose后紧接名词，不等于who’s。

rules.structure: 限定性从句中只可省略宾语关系词
rules.use: 主语不可省；非限制性不可省
rules.example: The course (that) I selected is affordable.
rules.explanation: I selected the course：省略宾语that仍完整。不能把Students who study...中的who省掉。

examples.en: Students who receive regular feedback often make faster progress.
examples.cn: 定期获得反馈的学生通常进步更快。
split: Students often make faster progress.
These students receive regular feedback.
examples.note: 这是一般教学例句，不是经验数据结论。

examples.en: The table compares companies whose employees work remotely.
examples.cn: 该表比较了员工远程办公的公司。
split: The table compares companies.
The employees of these companies work remotely.

mistakes.wrong: Students who they study regularly improve.
The tool which measures... → The tool measures...
mistakes.correct: 保留which：The tool which measures temperature is useful.
mistakes.why: 删掉主语关系词会改变结构；此处主句谓语是is。

exercises.cn: 经常阅读新闻的学生能够接触不同观点。
exercises.answer: Students who read the news regularly can encounter different perspectives.
exercises.explanation: who代替students；从句不再加they。

exercises.cn: 这张图比较了使用太阳能的家庭。
exercises.answer: The chart compares households that use solar energy.
exercises.explanation: households作use的主语；主句是The chart compares households。

exercises.cn: 市政府聘用的专家提出了一个新方案。
exercises.answer: The expert whom the council employed proposed a new plan.
exercises.explanation: the council employed the expert；whom是宾语。
exercises.alternative: The expert the council employed proposed a new plan.

exercises.cn: 那些父母无力负担学费的孩子需要额外支持。
exercises.answer: Children whose parents cannot afford tuition fees need additional support.
exercises.explanation: whose parents表示孩子们的父母；从句谓语cannot afford。

exercises.cn: 我选择的培训课程包括实际操作练习。
exercises.hint: 省略限定性从句中的宾语关系词
exercises.answer: The training course I selected includes practical exercises.
exercises.explanation: I selected the course；省略的是宾语that/which，主句谓语是includes。

exercises.cn: 合并：The machine is energy-efficient. Its motor was redesigned.
exercises.answer: The machine whose motor was redesigned is energy-efficient.
exercises.explanation: whose motor＝the machine’s motor；whose不只修饰人。

lessons.title: 02 关系副词：where / when / why
lessons.goal: 区分缺少地点、时间、原因状语与缺少主语或宾语。
lessons.principle: where、when、why在从句中作状语。从句的主谓宾通常已经完整；它们不是遇到地点、时间、reason就自动使用的标签。
steps: 检查从句动词是否已有所需主语和宾语。
缺“在那里/那时/因为那个原因”等状语时再用where/when/why。
若缺visited、remembered等动词的宾语，使用which/that或合适的省略结构。

rules.example: The fruit reaches a factory, where it is sorted.
rules.explanation: it is sorted已有主语it；where＝in/at which，地点介词依原句而定。

rules.example: The year when sales peaked was 2018.
rules.explanation: sales peaked in that year；when＝in which。

rules.example: The reason why some people avoid museums is the admission fee.
rules.explanation: some people avoid museums for that reason；why常用于限定性结构。

rules.structure: 地点/时间＋which / that＋缺宾语分句
rules.use: 关系词作宾语而非状语
rules.example: The factory that the inspectors visited was modern.
rules.explanation: inspectors visited the factory：visited后缺宾语，不能改成where。

rules.use: 只保留一个地点连接位置
rules.example: The cans reach supermarkets, where they are displayed.
rules.explanation: 不要写where they are displayed there。抽象的situation可用where，但不要把所有抽象名词都当地点。

examples.en: Initially, fresh fruit is packed and transported to a factory, where it is sorted to remove unsuitable produce.
examples.cn: 首先，新鲜水果被包装并运到工厂，在那里经过分拣以去除不合适的果品。
examples.main: Fresh fruit is packed and transported to a factory.
examples.clause: where it is sorted to remove unsuitable produce
split: Fresh fruit is packed and transported to a factory.
At the factory, it is sorted to remove unsuitable produce.
examples.note: 用户提供的流程图练习句；依原图确认实际加工顺序。

examples.en: Finally, the packaged cans are transported to supermarkets, where they are ready for sale.
examples.cn: 最后，包装好的罐头被运往超市，在那里准备出售。
examples.main: The packaged cans are transported to supermarkets.
examples.clause: where they are ready for sale
split: The packaged cans are transported to supermarkets.
There, they are ready for sale.
examples.note: packaged已校正；where表示超市这一地点。

mistakes.wrong: The factory where inspectors visited was modern.
mistakes.correct: The factory that inspectors visited was modern.
mistakes.why: visited后缺宾语；不是缺地点状语。

mistakes.wrong: The year when I remember was 2010.
mistakes.correct: The year that I remember was 2010.
mistakes.why: remember需要宾语；若说sales rose in that year，则可用when。

exercises.cn: 随后，牛奶被运到一家工厂，在那里被加热。
exercises.answer: The milk is then transported to a factory, where it is heated.
exercises.explanation: where指在工厂里；it指milk。

exercises.cn: 2019年是公交乘客人数达到峰值的年份。
exercises.answer: 2019 was the year when bus passenger numbers peaked.
exercises.explanation: bus passenger numbers peaked本身完整；when提供时间。

exercises.cn: 价格较高是一些居民不使用该服务的原因。
exercises.answer: The high price is the reason why some residents do not use the service.
exercises.explanation: why补充do not use the service的原因。

exercises.cn: 政府检查过的那家工厂位于河边。
exercises.answer: The factory that government inspectors visited is beside the river.
exercises.explanation: inspectors visited后缺宾语the factory，所以用that/which。

exercises.cn: 包装后的产品被送到商店，在那里展示给顾客。
exercises.answer: The packaged products are sent to shops, where they are displayed to customers.
exercises.explanation: they指products，where指shops中的地点。

exercises.cn: 合并：The centre has a laboratory. Researchers test new materials in the laboratory.
exercises.answer: The centre has a laboratory where researchers test new materials.
exercises.explanation: researchers test new materials已有主谓宾；where补充in the laboratory。

lessons.title: 03 介词＋which / whom：by which / to which
lessons.goal: 从动词搭配或原句意义推导介词，而不是死记“介词＋which”。
lessons.principle: 把从句还原成独立句，先确定by / to / in / from / for等介词，再把“介词＋先行词”移到从句前。正式结构中介词后用which（物）或whom（人），不用that。
steps: 还原：Fruit is produced by this process；water is added to the cans。
保留原搭配的介词：by this process→by which；to the cans→to which。
移走重复名词；其余从句结构完整。不要把介词错误地换成where。

rules.example: The diagram illustrates the process by which canned fruit is produced.
rules.explanation: 还原：canned fruit is produced by this process；by which是方式状语。

rules.use: add A to B的接受对象
rules.example: The fruit is placed in cans, to which juice is added.
rules.explanation: 还原：juice is added to the cans；to来自add...to...，不来自which。

rules.example: The fruit reaches a factory, at which it is sorted.
rules.explanation: 常可改为where，但by which、to which不能机械换为where。

rules.structure: 来源＋from which / 对象＋for which
rules.use: 来自某物/为某目的或对象
rules.example: The tank from which water is pumped is cleaned daily.
rules.explanation: 还原：water is pumped from the tank；依据语义选择介词。

rules.use: 正式表达中的介词宾语
rules.example: The adviser to whom residents spoke explained the policy.
rules.explanation: 还原：residents spoke to the adviser；不要写to who或to that。

examples.en: The diagram illustrates the process by which canned fruit is produced and prepared for sale in supermarkets.
examples.cn: 该图展示了水果罐头的生产及为超市销售做准备的过程。
examples.clause: by which canned fruit is produced and prepared for sale in supermarkets
examples.role: by which＝by this process；which是介词by的宾语
split: The diagram illustrates the process.
Canned fruit is produced and prepared for sale in supermarkets by this process.

examples.en: The prepared fruit is subsequently placed in cans, to which either water, juice or syrup is added.
examples.cn: 随后，处理好的水果被装入罐中，再向罐中加入水、果汁或糖浆中的一种。
examples.main: The prepared fruit is subsequently placed in cans.
examples.clause: to which either water, juice or syrup is added
examples.role: add liquid to cans→liquid is added to cans；which是to的宾语
split: The prepared fruit is subsequently placed in cans.
Either water, juice or syrup is added to these cans.
examples.note: water已校正；to which表示添加的目标容器。

mistakes.wrong: the process by that fruit is produced
mistakes.correct: the process by which fruit is produced

mistakes.wrong: cans, to which syrup is added to them
mistakes.correct: cans, to which syrup is added
mistakes.why: to which已代表to the cans，不再重复to them。先还原add syrup to the cans，再选介词。

exercises.cn: 该图展示了废纸被回收制成纸板的过程。
exercises.answer: The diagram illustrates the process by which waste paper is recycled into cardboard.
exercises.explanation: by来自by this process；不要用by that。

exercises.cn: 混合物被倒入一个容器，随后向该容器中加入盐。
exercises.hint: 用to which；add salt to the container
exercises.answer: The mixture is poured into a container, to which salt is then added.
exercises.explanation: salt is added to the container；to which引出接受盐的容器。

exercises.cn: 这是用于收集雨水的水箱。
exercises.hint: 用in which；rainwater is collected in the tank
exercises.answer: This is the tank in which rainwater is collected.
exercises.explanation: in the tank被换为in which；不要重复in it。

exercises.cn: 储存原油的容器与原油被抽出的储罐相连。
exercises.answer: The container holding crude oil is connected to the storage tank from which oil is pumped.
exercises.explanation: oil is pumped from the storage tank，from表示来源。

exercises.cn: 学生可以求助的顾问会提供有用的反馈。
exercises.answer: Advisers to whom students can turn provide useful feedback.
exercises.explanation: students can turn to the advisers；主句主语Advisers，谓语provide。

exercises.cn: 该报告解释了新材料被测试的程序。
exercises.answer: The report explains the procedure through which new materials are tested.
exercises.explanation: tested through this procedure表达通过这个程序；也可以依语义用by which。

lessons.title: 04 限定与非限定：逗号、whose及数量结构
lessons.goal: 区分“辨认哪一个”与“对已确定对象补充信息”。
lessons.principle: 限定性从句帮助确定指的是哪一类对象；非限制性从句用逗号隔开，添加补充信息。逗号并非装饰，可能改变句子涵盖的范围。
steps: 先问：删掉从句后，读者是否仍知道具体对象？
需要辨认时通常不加逗号；补充已确定对象时使用逗号。
非限制性不用that，关系词不能省略；置于主句中间时两侧都要逗号。

rules.example: Factories that recycle water use fewer fresh supplies.
rules.explanation: 只谈回收用水的工厂，不能推断所有工厂都回收。

rules.structure: 已确定对象，which / who...，主句其余部分
rules.example: The main factory, which opened in 2005, employs 200 people.
rules.explanation: which从句插在主语与谓语之间，两侧逗号成对。

rules.example: The school, whose library was renovated, now serves more pupils.
rules.explanation: whose并不限于人；逗号不改变whose的所属功能。

rules.structure: 复数名词，some / most / many of which / whom...
rules.use: 对前面群体中的部分作补充
rules.example: The survey covered ten towns, most of which had public libraries.
rules.explanation: towns是物用which；students是人可用whom；数量和范围须有依据。

examples.en: The survey covered six factories, two of which recycled their wastewater.
examples.cn: 调查涵盖六家工厂，其中两家回收废水。
examples.clause: two of which recycled their wastewater
examples.role: two of which整体作从句主语；which指six factories
split: The survey covered six factories.
Two of these factories recycled their wastewater.
examples.note: 练习数据，不对应题库原图。

examples.en: The college, whose fees increased in 2020, introduced more scholarships.
examples.cn: 这所学院的学费在2020年上涨，它推出了更多奖学金。
split: The college introduced more scholarships.
Its fees increased in 2020.

mistakes.wrong: The main plant, that opened in 2005, is modern.
mistakes.correct: The main plant, which opened in 2005, is modern.

mistakes.wrong: The school, whose facilities are old needs funding.
mistakes.correct: The school, whose facilities are old, needs funding.
mistakes.why: 插入式非限制性从句两侧逗号配对。

exercises.cn: 主图书馆于2010年开放，现在每周接待500名访客。
exercises.hint: 用插入式which从句；数据为练习设定
exercises.answer: The main library, which opened in 2010, now receives 500 visitors a week.
exercises.explanation: which opened in 2010是补充信息，主句为library receives visitors。

exercises.cn: 调查包括八个城镇，其中五个有医院。
exercises.answer: The survey included eight towns, five of which had hospitals.
exercises.explanation: five of which作had的主语；不能说five of that。

exercises.cn: 这些学生更喜欢晚间课程，其中许多人在兼职。
exercises.answer: The students, many of whom worked part-time, preferred evening courses.
exercises.explanation: many of whom指这些学生中的许多人；preferred是主句谓语。

exercises.cn: 这家工厂的设备去年进行了更新，现在用电更少。
exercises.answer: The factory, whose equipment was upgraded last year, now uses less electricity.
exercises.explanation: whose equipment为从句主语，equipment不可数，配was。

exercises.cn: 比较并翻译：只有提供免费课程的学校才获得这项补助。
exercises.hint: 用限定性that/who/which结构，不加逗号
exercises.answer: Only schools that offer free courses receive this grant.
exercises.explanation: 从句筛选出提供免费课程的学校；加逗号会改变范围。

exercises.cn: 处理好的产品被运往港口，在那里等待出口。
exercises.answer: The processed products are transported to the port, where they await export.
exercises.explanation: port已由语境确定时where补充地点；they指products。

lessons.title: 05 which指代整句：结果与范围
lessons.goal: 区分which修饰一个名词与which评论前面整件事。
lessons.principle: 逗号＋which可以指代前面整个事实，常用于表达结果或评价。which指的是整件事，不一定是最近的名词；但指代不清时应拆句。
steps: 先写完整事实，再决定是否需要结果说明。
检查which究竟指一个名词，还是前面整个事件。
Task 1只写图上可见的变化或能直接算出的关系，不推断健康、经济等未给出的因果。

rules.example: Bus use doubled, which represented the largest increase shown.
rules.explanation: which指公交使用量翻倍这一变化；结果须由图中数据支持。

rules.example: The machines, which are inspected daily, are expensive.
rules.explanation: which指machines；用are。若指前述整件事，通常视为单一事实配单数谓语。

rules.example: The city reduced fares. This reduction made travel more affordable.
rules.explanation: 比在复杂长句尾机械加which更清楚。

rules.structure: which不能作为独立句的连接词
rules.example: The service became cheaper, which attracted more users.
rules.explanation: 不要写The service became cheaper. Which attracted...作为完整句子。

examples.en: The share of bus journeys rose from 20% to 40%, which represented a doubling over the period.
examples.cn: 公交出行份额由20%升至40%，在这段时期翻了一倍。
examples.main: The share of bus journeys rose from 20% to 40%.
examples.clause: which represented a doubling over the period
split: The share of bus journeys rose from 20% to 40%.
This change represented a doubling over the period.
examples.note: 这些数值仅为训练设定；翻倍可以直接算出。

mistakes.why: which从句不能独立成句；利润变化还需要数据或论据支持。

mistakes.wrong: The rate rose from 20% to 30%, which proves people became healthier.
mistakes.correct: The rate rose from 20% to 30%, an increase of 10 percentage points.
mistakes.why: 给定比例可计算出增加10个百分点，但不能由此证明人们健康改善。练习数值不对应题库原图。

exercises.cn: 在这项练习数据中，销售额从100万升至200万，意味着翻了一倍。
exercises.answer: Sales rose from one million to two million, which represented a doubling.
exercises.explanation: which指销售额从一百万升至两百万的变化，不是指two million这个名词。

exercises.cn: 图中公交出行份额由20%升至35%，增加了15个百分点。
exercises.answer: The share of bus journeys rose from 20% to 35%, which represented an increase of 15 percentage points.
exercises.explanation: 35%-20%=15个百分点；不是相对增加15%。

exercises.cn: 降低课程费用让更多家庭能够负担教育。
exercises.answer: The school reduced its course fees, which made education more affordable for more families.
exercises.explanation: which指降低费用这一行为；这是Task 2机制练习。

exercises.cn: 学校引入了同伴辅导，这可能有助于缺乏信心的学习者。
exercises.answer: The school introduced peer tutoring, which may help learners who lack confidence.
exercises.explanation: which指引入同伴辅导的做法；who则修饰learners。

exercises.cn: 改写避免指代不清：The council closed the road near the school, which upset residents.
exercises.hint: 拆成两句，明确“封路”引发不满
exercises.answer: The council closed the road near the school. This closure upset residents.
exercises.explanation: 把which替换成This closure，避免读者误解为school引发不满。

exercises.cn: 合并：The recycling rate remained at 30%. This stability contrasted with the rise in the other city.
exercises.answer: The recycling rate remained at 30%, which contrasted with the rise in the other city.
exercises.explanation: which指该回收率保持不变的事实，而不是擅自说明变化原因。

lessons.title: 06 名词性从句：that / whether / what / how
lessons.goal: 区分整句作主语、宾语、表语，以及解释事实内容的同位语从句。
lessons.principle: 名词性从句整体承担名词的功能，不一定修饰前面的名词。that从句通常不缺成分；what在从句里还充当主语或宾语；whether表示是否。
steps: 定位：从句是“我认为的内容”，还是在修饰某个对象？
从句完整可用that；缺“……的事物”用what；提出是否用whether。
所有嵌入式疑问从句使用陈述语序：how the process works，而非how does the process work。

rules.example: The chart shows that bus use increased.
rules.explanation: that只连接，不在bus use increased中作主语或宾语。

rules.example: Whether a policy succeeds depends on its implementation.
rules.explanation: 不用If a policy succeeds作同样意义的正式主语从句。

rules.example: What learners need is regular feedback.
rules.explanation: learners need something；what填need的宾语位置。

rules.example: The diagram explains how waste is processed.
rules.explanation: how waste is processed用陈述语序；不用how is waste processed。

rules.example: The fact that fees are high does not prove that courses are effective.
rules.explanation: 第一个that是同位语从句连接词；后一个that引导prove的宾语从句。

examples.en: The diagram explains how household waste is converted into electricity.
examples.cn: 该图解释家庭垃圾如何被转化为电力。
examples.antecedent: 不修饰先行词；整个从句是explains的宾语
examples.clause: how household waste is converted into electricity
examples.role: how说明方式；从句整体作宾语
split: The diagram explains the conversion process.
Household waste is converted into electricity through this process.

mistakes.wrong: The diagram shows how is fruit processed.
mistakes.correct: The diagram shows how fruit is processed.
mistakes.why: 嵌入式疑问从句用陈述语序。
need缺宾语，“所需之物”用what；that不承担宾语成分。

exercises.cn: 该图显示公共交通使用量在2010年后增加了。
exercises.answer: The graph shows that public transport use increased after 2010.
exercises.explanation: that后的分句完整，整体作shows的宾语。

exercises.cn: 一个政策是否有效取决于它的实施方式。
exercises.answer: Whether a policy is effective depends on how it is implemented.
exercises.explanation: 主语整体是whether从句；depends用单数。

exercises.cn: 学习者真正需要的是定期反馈。
exercises.answer: What learners really need is regular feedback.
exercises.explanation: what在从句中作need的宾语。

exercises.cn: 该流程图解释了牛奶如何加工成奶酪。
exercises.answer: The process diagram explains how milk is processed into cheese.
exercises.explanation: how milk is processed，不倒装。

exercises.cn: 课程昂贵这一事实并不意味着它们更有效。
exercises.hint: 用the fact that＋does not mean that
exercises.answer: The fact that courses are expensive does not mean that they are more effective.
exercises.explanation: 第一个that说明fact内容，第二个that引导mean的宾语。

exercises.cn: 关键问题是低收入家庭能否负担这些服务。
exercises.answer: The key question is whether low-income families can afford these services.
exercises.explanation: whether从句整体作is后的表语；不使用疑问语序。

lessons.title: 07 让步与对比：although / while / whereas
lessons.goal: 区分“虽然但仍然”与两组数据的并列对比。
lessons.principle: although表示让步；whereas表示对比；while既可表示对比或让步，也可表示同时发生。根据逻辑关系选连接词，不把它们当可随意替换的装饰。
steps: 有预期落差时用although：虽有优势，仍非必要。
两组数据形成对照时用whereas或表示对比的while。
although不再配but；despite后接名词/动名词，不直接接完整分句。

rules.example: Although small classes offer benefits, they are not essential.
rules.explanation: 承认益处不等于认定必要；不要写Although..., but...。

rules.example: Bus use rose, whereas car use declined.
rules.explanation: 两边各有主谓；whereas表示对照，不表示时间。

rules.use: 对比或让步；需语境明确
rules.example: While online courses are convenient, they require self-discipline.
rules.explanation: 此处是让步；不是在描述两个同时发生的动作。

rules.example: Despite the high fees, demand remained strong.
rules.explanation: despite不是从属连词；它后面不能直接接fees were high。

examples.en: Although smaller classes can offer more individual attention, they are not essential to successful language learning.
examples.cn: 虽然小班能提供更多个别关注，但并非成功学习语言的必要条件。
examples.main: They are not essential to successful language learning.
examples.antecedent: 不适用；这是让步状语从句
examples.clause: Although smaller classes can offer more individual attention
examples.role: 从句承认优势，主句给出整体判断
split: Smaller classes can offer more individual attention.
They are not essential to successful language learning.

mistakes.wrong: Although fees were high, but demand rose.
mistakes.correct: Although fees were high, demand rose.
mistakes.why: although与but不在此结构中双重连接。

mistakes.wrong: Despite fees were high, demand rose.
mistakes.correct: Despite the high fees, demand rose.
mistakes.why: despite后改为名词短语；也可用Although fees were high。

exercises.cn: 虽然网课很方便，但它们需要较强的自律。
exercises.answer: Although online courses are convenient, they require strong self-discipline.
exercises.explanation: 承认便利后提出限制，属于让步。

exercises.cn: 汽车使用量下降，而公交使用量上升。
exercises.answer: Car use declined, whereas bus use increased.
exercises.explanation: 两组数据对比，不需要说明因果。

exercises.cn: 虽然小班更贵，但它们能提供更多互动机会。
exercises.answer: While small classes are more expensive, they can offer more opportunities for interaction.
exercises.explanation: while从句与主句分别完整。

exercises.cn: 尽管学费较高，这些课程仍然很受欢迎。
exercises.answer: Despite the high tuition fees, these courses remained popular.
exercises.explanation: despite后不能直接写tuition fees were high。

exercises.cn: 虽然回收率有所上升，它仍低于另外两个国家。
exercises.answer: Although the recycling rate increased, it remained below those of the other two countries.
exercises.explanation: it指该国单数rate；those代替其他两国的rates。

exercises.cn: 改错：Although public transport is affordable, but some residents still drive.
exercises.answer: Although public transport is affordable, some residents still drive.
exercises.explanation: 保留although后删除but；也可删除although保留but。

lessons.title: 08 时间与条件：once / after / if / unless
lessons.goal: 描述工序先后、政策前提与未来变化，控制时态和主语。
lessons.principle: 时间从句说明先后，条件从句说明成立前提。主句表达未来时，时间或条件从句通常用一般现在时表示未来；不要在if或once从句里机械使用will。
steps: 工序顺序选after / before / once / until；必要前提选if / unless。
确定谁完成该步骤；被加工对象往往用被动语态。
未来主句可用will，但条件/时间从句通常用现在时；unless本身含if not，不再多加not。

rules.example: Once the cans are sealed, they are heated.
rules.explanation: 流程概述用一般现在时被动语态；两句的they都指cans。

rules.use: 先于某步骤/直到某条件
rules.example: The product is stored until it is ready for distribution.
rules.explanation: until表示一直持续到某时，不等于before。

rules.example: If fares fall, more people may use buses.
rules.explanation: 主句保留may表示可能性；不保证政策必然有效。

rules.example: Unless services improve, demand may remain low.
rules.explanation: 不要写Unless services do not improve表达同一个意思。

rules.example: After washing the fruit, workers pack it.
rules.explanation: 洗水果的是workers。不要写After washing the fruit, it is packed来让fruit似乎自己洗水果；可用After the fruit is washed, it is packed。

examples.en: Once the cans have been sealed, they are heated to preserve the contents.
examples.cn: 罐子密封之后，会被加热以保存其中的食物。
examples.main: They are heated to preserve the contents.
examples.antecedent: 不适用；这是时间状语从句
examples.clause: Once the cans have been sealed
examples.role: 表示先完成密封，再进行加热
split: The cans are sealed.
They are then heated to preserve the contents.
examples.note: 流程练习用一般现在时或现在完成时从句表达先后；具体工艺以图示为准。

mistakes.wrong: If the government will lower fares, more people may use buses.
mistakes.correct: If the government lowers fares, more people may use buses.
mistakes.why: 一般未来条件句的if从句通常不用will表示将来。

mistakes.wrong: After washing the fruit, it is packed.
mistakes.correct: After the fruit is washed, it is packed.
mistakes.why: 避免悬垂的主动分词；或改成After washing the fruit, workers pack it。

exercises.cn: 罐子密封后，会被加热。
exercises.answer: Once the cans are sealed, they are heated.
exercises.explanation: the cans are sealed是完整时间从句；主句they指cans。

exercises.cn: 水果清洗后，工人把它切成小块。
exercises.answer: After the fruit is washed, workers cut it into small pieces.
exercises.explanation: 完整从句明确fruit为被清洗对象，避免悬垂分词。

exercises.cn: 如果政府降低票价，更多人可能乘坐公交车。
exercises.answer: If the government lowers fares, more people may use buses.
exercises.explanation: lowers表示未来条件；may保留对政策效果的谨慎判断。

exercises.cn: 除非公共服务改善，否则居民可能继续开车。
exercises.answer: Unless public services improve, residents may continue to drive.
exercises.explanation: unless public services improve＝if public services do not improve。

exercises.cn: 产品一直储存到准备好配送为止。
exercises.answer: The products are stored until they are ready for distribution.
exercises.explanation: until强调储存持续至准备好配送这一时间点。

exercises.cn: 改错：After cleaning the jars, they are filled with juice.
exercises.hint: 写清清洗动作的施事者或改完整被动从句
exercises.answer: After the jars are cleaned, they are filled with juice.
exercises.explanation: 原句让they/jars成为cleaning的逻辑主语；改被动从句明确动作关系。
exercises.alternative: After cleaning the jars, workers fill them with juice.
